title: Analyzing and Improving Chain-of-Thought Monitorability Through Information Theory
abstract: arXiv:2602.18297v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitors are LLM-based systems that analyze reasoning traces to detect when outputs may exhibit attributes of interest, such as test-hacking behavior during code generation. In this paper, we use information-theoretic analysis to show that non-zero mutual information between CoT and output is a necessary but not sufficient condition for CoT monitorability. We identify two sources of approximation error that may undermine the performance of CoT monitors in practice: information gap, which measures the extent to which the monitor can extract the information available in CoT, and elicitation error, which measures the extent to which the monitor approximates the optimal monitoring function. Empirically, we show that CoT obfuscation can arise even in the absence of any optimization pressure against CoT. translated_title: 基于信息论的思维链可监控性分析与改进
translated_abstract: 思维链监控器是一类基于大语言模型的系统，通过分析推理轨迹来检测输出是否可能表现出特定关注属性，例如代码生成过程中“钻测试空子”的行为。本文利用信息论分析表明，思维链与输出之间具有非零互信息是思维链可监控性的必要条件，但并非充分条件。我们识别出两类可能在实际中削弱思维链监控器性能的近似误差来源：信息鸿沟，衡量监控器能够从思维链中提取可用信息的程度；以及引导误差，衡量监控器逼近最优监控函数的程度。实证研究显示，即使不存在任何针对思维链的优化压力，思维链混淆仍可能出现。我们进一步证明，思维链可监控性的脆弱性可以通过针对性干预得到系统性缓解。
tldr: 本文用信息论揭示了思维链可监控性的必要非充分条件，识别出信息鸿沟和引导误差两类失效来源，发现思维链混淆可在无优化压力下自发出现，并证明可通过针对性干预系统性缓解监控的脆弱性。
